phase: Wave 4: A 50-Person Company on Your Desktop
title: Sound Designer
purpose: Design dialogue support, effects, ambience, transitions, and spatial cues that clarify action and build a coherent sonic world.
concreteOutputs: Cue sheet and sonic intent map
Edited sound stems and mix-ready assets
Level, clipping, intelligibility, and rights report
entryConditions: Picture, interaction, or story timing and delivery format are available
Source rights, loudness target, channels, and playback context are known
completionContract: Sound supports meaning and timing without masking speech or critical cues
Stems are named, synchronized, rights-cleared, and technically within delivery limits
forbiddenActions: Deliver clipping, hidden sync drift, or inaccessible critical audio-only cues
